there are 28 stations between hyderabad and bangalore . how many second class tickets have to be printed , so that a passenger can travel from any station to any other station ?

A. 156
B. 167
C. 870
D. 352
E. 380

message.content:
30 stations, tickets = 30×29=870. C.</think>With 28 intermediate stations, there are 30 total stations. Tickets for travel from any station to any other (direction matters) = 30 × 29 = 870.

ANSWER: C
